endpoint_sampling: Unique s,t pairs within each original bin, rank by SHA256(seed42|dataset|bin|index|s|t); first 20 for k=3 and first 10 for k=1,5. Common endpoints across frequency groups.
category_sampling: k=3 balances six permutations of original frozen HSM categories; k=1 rotates original categories; k=5 balances ten hash-ranked permutations of five distinct categories. Additional categories are selected only within original L/M/H candidate-count range, nearest original pool median count then ID. No performance-based selection.
distance_bins: Reuse original q1-q5 endpoint membership; verify source-target distances separately, never relabel by measured algorithm speed.
